query:
SELECT CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MIN(COALESCE(p.release_at, g.start_at)) - NOW())))::BIGINT
        FROM rb_puzzle p
        JOIN rb_game g ON g.id = p.game_id
        JOIN rb_team_puzzle tp ON tp.puzzle_id = p.id
            AND tp.team_id = $1
            AND tp.state >= 0
        WHERE p.round_id = $2
            AND COALESCE(p.release_at, g.start_at) > NOW();
